hero.title_secondary: Live paper call shield for Indian families
hero.description: Live paper call sheet that marks scam red flags and speaks aloud when to hang up.
hero.disclaimer: Sajag is a helper, not a guarantee.
hero.hang_up_alert: Hang up now — do not send money

modes.title: Three ways to protect your family
modes.live_desc: Place a phone or laptop beside the speakerphone. Sajag transcribes speech in real time with Gnani Prisma and warns you instantly.
modes.check_desc: Upload a voice note or call recording from WhatsApp or recorder (up to 3 minutes).
modes.paste_desc: Paste an SMS, WhatsApp forward, or transcript. Analyzed entirely on-device by our rules engine.

steps.title: How Sajag works
steps.step1_desc: Prisma v2.5 listens to code-mixed Hindi, Hinglish, and English telephony audio directly from your speaker.
steps.step2_desc: A deterministic rule engine marks suspicious phrases with highlighter strokes and hard traps with vermilion circles.
steps.step3_desc: Timbre speaks a calm, clear alert in your mother tongue so elders know immediately when to hang up.

languages.title: Built for how India actually speaks
languages.subtitle: No robotic English menus. Real code-mixed Hindi, Hinglish, and regional speech over noisy phone lines.

scams.title: Scams Sajag knows
scams.subtitle: Common traps identified by pattern, authority claims, urgency, and money requests. Tap any scam to see how Sajag marks it.

digital_arrest.title: Digital arrest
digital_arrest.desc: Claims to be police, CBI, or customs, threatens a court case or arrest, and orders you to stay on a video call.
digital_arrest.sample: Supreme Court order: you are under digital arrest. Transfer funds to safe account.

bank_kyc.title: Fake bank KYC
bank_kyc.desc: Warns your account, SIM, or card will be blocked tonight unless you update details and share an OTP.
bank_kyc.sample: Your SBI debit card will be blocked by midnight. Share the 6-digit OTP to verify.

upi_refund.title: Refund or wrong payment
upi_refund.desc: Claims money was sent by mistake, asks you to scan a QR code or enter your UPI PIN to receive money.
upi_refund.sample: Madam, I sent twenty thousand by mistake. Enter your UPI PIN to approve the refund.

utility_disconnect.title: Electricity / utility cut
utility_disconnect.desc: Urgent SMS or call claiming power will be cut in 30 minutes unless a bill is paid to a private number.
utility_disconnect.sample: Electricity officer speaking. Pay unpaid bill of 1,480 rupees now or power cuts at 9 PM.

courier_parcel.title: Courier and customs
courier_parcel.desc: Alleges a parcel in your name contains narcotics or contraband, demanding immediate money to clear it.
courier_parcel.sample: FedEx Mumbai: your parcel to Taiwan contains illegal passports and MDMA drugs.

tech_support_remote.title: Remote access apps
tech_support_remote.desc: Instructs you to install AnyDesk, TeamViewer, or an APK so they can assist you.
tech_support_remote.sample: To fix your banking app error, install QuickSupport from this link and read the 9 digits.

family_emergency.title: Family emergency
family_emergency.desc: Claims your child or relative was arrested or injured, asking for urgent money and strict secrecy.
family_emergency.sample: Uncle, your nephew was detained in a police raid. Send fifty thousand for bail immediately.

lottery_prize.title: Lottery & prizes
lottery_prize.desc: Tells you that you won a lottery or reward, but demands an upfront processing fee.
lottery_prize.sample: Congratulations! You won 25 lakh rupees in KBC lottery. Deposit 12,500 rupees GST first.

investment_task.title: Part-time task & investment
investment_task.desc: Promises guaranteed returns for liking videos or joining Telegram investment groups.
investment_task.sample: Earn 3,000 rupees daily just liking YouTube hotel videos. Deposit 5,000 for VIP task.

parent_band.title: Simple enough for grandparents
parent_band.description: Parent mode has one giant button, huge high-contrast text, full-screen color fields, and speaks loud Hindi warnings automatically.

limits.title: Honest limits
limits.body: Sajag is a helper, not an official guarantee. Same-phone live call recording is restricted by phone operating systems, so Sajag uses a second device, uploaded recordings, or pasted text. No blocking, no official police authority.
limits.link: Read our full privacy and limitations policy

footer.credits: Speech recognition and voice by Gnani Prisma and Timbre
footer.privacy: Zero call recordings or transcripts stored. Privacy by design.
footer.disclaimer: Sajag is an advisory shield, not a legal guarantee.
